messages.author: frank
messages.content: Send `currency` explicitly. It defaults to "usd" server-side, but clients should always include it. Recap of the agreed v2 charge body: api_version 2; amount_cents (int cents); customer; currency ("usd" unless otherwise); idempotency_key (required). v1's `amount` (dollars) and `account` are both gone.
